notablePrerequisites:
Dual Casting attached to Torchling.
Torchling does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Pyretic Ritual by paying {1}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Torchling by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Pyretic Ritual.
Resolve the copy of Pyretic Ritual, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Torchling by paying {R}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
